svg.desc: Separate parietal decoding and motor-cortical bidirectional interfaces show outgoing device control and returning visual or tactile information. A: posterior parietal recording, decoder, device controller, robotic limb; vision returns. B, a different participant and study: motor-cortical recording controls a robotic arm; finger torque drives a stimulation encoder and somatosensory stimulation, felt as sensations referred to the hand; vision remains available. Schematic.

g.text: robotic limb (a cursor was also used)
